title: A library inside a pi-kit domain

domain.description: The domain (the folder under libs/ and the scope:<domain> tag), e.g. threads, chat, settings.

type.description: The library type (type:<type> tag): api, feature, ui, data or util.

name.description: Required for a feature library (libs/<domain>/feature-<name>); the other types are one per domain and take none.

testing.description: angular: the Angular unit-test builder with jsdom (stores, components, TestBed); node: plain vitest (pure functions). Defaults to node for util and angular for the rest.
